scenarios.title: Reconfigure attaches the permanent to another creature you control, at sorcery timing
decisions: A activates Lizard Blades' reconfigure ({2}) targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping two Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: main_phase
variants.expected: The ability resolves: Lizard Blades is attached to Grizzly Bears, which has double strike. Lizard Blades stops being a creature.

variants.label: opponents_creature
variants.delta: A targets B's Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The target is not legal (it must be another creature A controls). The ability is not activated and Lizard Blades stays unattached.

variants.label: combat_timing
variants.delta: A tries to activate the reconfigure ability in the beginning of combat step instead of main phase 1.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal (sorcery timing only). Lizard Blades stays unattached and the Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.title: Reconfigure unattaches the permanent only while it is attached
decisions: A activates Lizard Blades' second reconfigure ability ({2}, unattach), tapping two Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: attached
variants.expected: Lizard Blades becomes unattached and is a creature again, a 1/1 with double strike. Grizzly Bears loses double strike.

variants.label: not_attached
variants.delta: Lizard Blades is not attached to any creature.
variants.expected: The unattach ability cannot be activated (it is attached to nothing). Lizard Blades stays a 1/1 creature and the Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.title: An Equipment with reconfigure is not a creature while attached to a creature
decisions: A tries to declare Lizard Blades and Grizzly Bears as attackers against B.

variants.label: attached
variants.expected: Lizard Blades is only an Artifact Equipment, not a creature, so it cannot be declared as an attacker. Grizzly Bears (2/2 with double strike) attacks alone.

variants.label: unattached
variants.delta: Lizard Blades is not attached to Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Lizard Blades is an Artifact Creature Equipment Lizard 1/1 with double strike and can attack alongside Grizzly Bears (2/2 without double strike).
